title: The Lighthouse on the Deserted Island

image.alt: The Lighthouse on the Deserted Island banner

paragraphs: 津菈敎的內戰尚未止息。雖然站在優勢的那一方，羅賓遜主教仍苦惱不已。在方努爾市的教堂書庫內，一本被津菈敎典藏的魔法書，《雪の化身の目覚め》遭竊了。究竟是怎麼失竊的？小偷又是誰？雖然線索不足，但是在羅賓遜主教的心中已經有了答案。
津菈敎內戰的反對勢力由人稱「長城爵士」的湯馬士・湯普森爵士領導。《雪の化身の目覚め》一書極有可能落入他的手中，以扭轉他陷入敗北之地的悲慘命運。
在羅賓遜主教的號招之下，幾名勇者來到了教堂內，接受主教發派的任務—到一座無名小島上，找尋《雪の化身の目覚め》的蹤跡。這幾名勇者包括：地精嘿嘿嘿王子、半身人芬恩、半獸人拉雅米、妖精泰瓦爾、半獸人南恩，以及人類伊努。經過主教的說明，以及對賞金的討價還價後，冒險者們來到了方努爾市的港口，尋找傳聞中的瑪琳船長。
路上民眾的眼光沒有離開過這群裝扮奇異，行為更是古怪的冒險者們。終於來到了港口，芬恩出示了羅賓遜主教給的介紹信後，守衛便將他們帶到了瑪琳船長的船邊。冒險者們陸續與瑪琳船長自我介紹，登上了船。拉雅米興奮地從岸邊直接跳上甲板，驚動了正在甲板上忙碌的船員尼爾森與他的妻子海耶斯。待瑪琳船長在附近買了頭痛藥，重新登船後，他便拿起噴水器，向新船員們要求乖乖聽話，否則噴水器不會對他們手下留情。
詢問了新船員們的需求後，瑪琳船長指派了最後一位船員，萊恩去採買芬恩提出的菸草，以及伊努提出的帳篷與火把。同時間，瑪琳船長也帶著冒險者們在船上熟悉環境：船艙、餐廳、船長室，以及下層貨艙。南恩對船長室感到十分有興趣，卻在伸手要打開船長室的私人用品櫃時發現被鎖住了。其他人則對地下貨艙中堆積如山的麵包較有興趣。
隨著萊恩的歸來，大家紛紛領取貨品後便前往餐廳用餐。餐廳內，萊恩正和尼爾森以及海耶斯說明近期的戰事，伊努也同時在一旁聆聽，以及詢問關於長城爵士的消息。同時，嘿嘿嘿王子也詢問了關於瑪琳船長與津菈敎之間的事。南恩身在餐廳，心卻在船長室，想著船長的床，究竟是什麼味道？拉雅米因為不懂普通語，不知道大家到餐廳用晚餐了，因此跑到了下層貨艙大啖麵包。泰瓦爾則是躲在船艙內吃自己身上的乾糧。
晚餐後，拉雅米跑到了甲板上，做起了他平日會做的「獸人戰爭體操」。同為半獸人的南恩看見此狀，也開始跟著跳了起來。而身為戰爭牧師的泰瓦爾對此頗有意見，親自示範了正確的戰爭體操給他們看，他精湛的演出讓兩位半獸人感到無地自容。隨著萊恩的告誡，大夥兒才離開甲板，回到了臥艙內。
芬恩拿了整盒方才取得的高級雪茄，想漫步到甲板抽根菸。他分享給了跟在後頭的南恩以及正在甲板上清潔的萊恩各一根雪茄。夜色被雲霧給遮蓋住，散發出一股不安的氣息。遠處傳了一陣如咒語般的吟唱聲。芬恩和南恩都深刻感到一股惡寒，以及一道妖異的紅光，在黑夜中閃耀。萊恩見狀不妙，趕緊到船長室告知瑪琳船長。瑪琳船長來到了甲板，想利用望遠鏡觀測，船卻撞上了什麼似的劇烈晃動。瑪琳船長請芬恩和南恩到臥艙將夥伴們叫上甲板。
從臥艙往甲板的路有些狹窄，嘿嘿嘿王子突然想起自己的隨身物品還放在臥艙內，於是折返，卻發現臥艙已被海水浸入。黑暗的甲板上，伊努想在甲板上生火，以照亮視野，泰瓦爾見狀趕緊阻止，並利用法術將伊努的褲襠點亮，作為替代方案。
在船長的安排下，南恩和拉雅米協助將左側的救生艇從船上放下，而尼爾森和海耶斯則將右側的救生艇放下。積極的拉雅米一馬當先，卻在不理解滑輪和繩索的結構下，意外將降下救生艇的機關徹底破壞。瑪琳船長見狀，趕緊前往救援。在嘿嘿嘿王子一發火球的協助下，左側的救生艇終於放下，萊恩、泰瓦爾、拉雅米、伊努、南恩和芬恩等人隨著左側的救生艇降到了海面；瑪琳船長、尼爾森、海耶斯和嘿嘿嘿王子則搭上右側的救生艇。
兩艘救生艇漸行漸遠。到了荒島的岸上時，兩群人已經遙遠到見不到彼此的蹤影了。
跟隨著紅光，南恩和拉雅米將救生艇划向了荒島的沙灘上。疲憊的大家在沙灘上快要睡去，但是伴隨著他們的是一股詭異的刺骨之寒，因此在拉雅米和南恩的體力活下，砍下了一些柴，並生起了火，大家圍繞著火堆，才漸漸睡去。

另一艘救生艇上，瑪琳船長遞給了嘿嘿嘿王子一件禦寒的外套，上面充斥的不是嘿嘿嘿王子想像中女子的香氣，而是一陣極為濃厚的男子氣味。在瑪琳船長的導航下，他們停在了一處懸崖底下的沙灘旁。跟隨著詭異的紅光，四人爬上了山坡，向紅光的來源—懸崖上的燈塔前進。也因為逐漸寒冷的氣溫，眾人更不假思索的闖入了燈塔內。燈塔的一樓有廚房、休息室，以及兩間臥室。經過調查後，出乎眾人的意料，大家發現廚房內儲藏櫃內還有可以食用的糧食。憑著自身的夜視能力，嘿嘿嘿王子帶領大家到室外收集了一些柴火，帶回燈塔內，但是他們卻在森林中發現了一具乾枯卻沒有明顯外傷的屍體，最終他們決定將屍體帶回燈塔內，以便後續調查。在燈塔內，嘿嘿嘿王子與瑪琳船長繼續調查，發現了在休息室內的窗戶都被木板給釘死了。同時，嘿嘿嘿王子也在其中上鎖的金屬置物櫃內找到了一把長劍。
另一群登島的冒險者們在短暫的睡眠後醒來。眾人在狀態不佳的情況下，終於也找到了燈塔，便趕緊進了燈塔內，也終於見到了走散的其他夥伴們。
在繼續進行的調查中，嘿嘿嘿王子在臥房中找到了大量散落的紙張。將手寫的草稿收集並重新整理後，嘿嘿嘿王子發現這些手稿應該是針對《雪の化身の目覚め》書中內容的註記，但是由於內容繁多且似乎牽涉了複雜的魔法，嘿嘿嘿王子必須在不受干擾的情況下花足夠的時間才能讀完。在休息已充足的條件下，泰瓦爾接手了閱讀手稿的任務，而瑪琳船長也指派因較早開始休息，精神較為飽滿的尼爾森與海耶斯前往收集更多木材。

撿完木材並回到燈塔內的尼爾森與海耶斯選擇到了二樓的臥房休息。經過簡單閱讀後，泰瓦爾發現手稿主要分為四個部分：冬天之主的介紹、召喚冬天之主的儀式與活祭的奉獻、冬天之主的奴僕，以及面具。興奮的泰瓦爾用了三倍大的音量向眾人說明自己得到的資訊，卻被在二樓休息的尼爾森訓斥，表示自己的太太還在休息，請泰瓦爾放低音量。稍有收斂的泰瓦爾還是讓尼爾森感到不滿，而決定獨自外出收集更多木材。在泰瓦爾的說明下，大家理解到《雪の化身の目覚め》是用來召喚冬天之主的魔法書。冬天之主會伴隨著寒氣與暴風雪一同現身，當祂的形象具體化的瞬間，將會把週邊變成極寒世界。要成功召喚冬天之主的話需要獻上大量的活祭。另外冬天之主的僕人會嘗試召喚冬天之主。手稿上有記載冬天之主的僕人的召喚儀式以及僕人的弱點是他的冰冷心臟。只要手持炙熱的長槍貫穿僕人的心臟，僕人就會瞬間死亡。
大家聽完泰瓦爾的說明後面面相覷。瑪琳船長詢問了尼爾森與海耶斯的去處，得知尼爾森又到外頭收集木材，而海耶斯則在二樓休息。大夥兒決定對燈塔的內部繼續進行調查。

前往陰暗的地下室，泰瓦爾將拉雅米身上唯一的裝束：他的內褲，點亮，作為大家的光源。在踏入地下室的那一刻，大家便發現了地上用鮮血繪製而成的巨大儀式圖案，與泰瓦爾在書中看見的圖案一致。芬恩也在暖爐中找到一根撥火棒。伊努也在房間內找到了一本日記，內容包含了以下：「這真的是現實會發生的事情嗎？如果這是真實，那麼人類所構築的文明社會到底有多麼脆弱啊……。」、「將神召喚到此……。這個存在卑微且矮小的我將會完全改變這個世界。但是，只有我一個人是辦不到的。要獻上活祭品？還是說需要一個給建議的人？那從者呢？」、「這天終於來了。我將會超越自我存在，看見新世界的曙光…。若能顛覆一個常識，則可以在那裡建構出一個全新的理論。」。

回到一樓閒逛的芬恩發現了燈塔的後門，就在他推開後門的瞬間，看見大量殘破的屍塊散落在燈塔後方的雪地。身後的泰瓦爾便趕緊大聲通報大家。眾人來到了雪地探查，卻因為外頭太過寒冷，無法久留，而折返回燈塔內。大家到了二樓尼爾森與海耶斯的房間，想在裡頭討論，卻發現門縫散發出了寒冷的氣息—打開門後，迎面而來的是從敞開的窗外撲面的寒氣。還有一股香氣，以及門後有個重物……。是神情恐怖而扭曲的尼爾森的頭。芬恩連忙跑回燈塔後門外的雪地，發現屍體是被用蠻力撕碎，並從二樓的窗戶直直拋下，但芬恩卻無法從他的記憶中回想起有什麼動物有這般的能力。跟隨在後的拉雅米則在燈塔周圍，持續尋找線索。
嘿嘿嘿王子接手泰瓦爾閱讀的手稿，試圖將最後的內容讀完，卻屢屢受到打斷，讓他十分氣憤。伊努則在二樓找到了一間儲藏室，裡面堆滿了各式的儲藏品。
拉雅米繞著燈塔，發現眼前的腳印越來越多、越來越多，這一定是剛剛才留下的！掌握了（他覺得）極其重要的線索，拉雅米趕緊跑回燈塔內，向大家回報。
此時，眾人感到了比過往更加嚴寒的氣息。大家跑到了燈塔外，嘿嘿嘿王子發現燈塔頂端的紅光旁，有個晃動的人影，正吟唱著。嘿嘿嘿王子試圖利用火球攻擊塔頂的人，卻沒有射中，但也打斷了儀式的進行。那黑影從背後長出了翅膀，然後朝樹林飛去。
看見此相，芬恩掏出了小刀，在自己的手臂上劃了一道切口，並幻化成狼，讓嘿嘿嘿王子跳到他的背上，兩人便朝著森林的彼端衝刺。在南恩的呼喊下，拉雅米也拿起了大砍斧，朝著森林奔去。瑪琳船長從地下室拿了撥火棒，遞給南恩和泰瓦爾。然而因為拉雅米跑得太快，南恩和泰瓦爾只能朝著遠處內褲發出的光芒，追蹤拉雅米的方向。越跑越遠，嘿嘿嘿王子與芬恩也看見數量逐漸增加的動物屍體。而此時站在懸崖頂端的伊努看著森林，喊道：

paragraphs.quote: 「他們進去森林了嗎？我要對著森林放火。」
paragraphs.cite: 伊努，（有極大潛力成為）縱火累犯

paragraphs: 瑪琳船長見狀趕緊阻止伊努。森林中泰瓦爾和南恩發現一頭鹿竟然和其他動物朝著不同的方向，向燈塔衝去。南恩對他射了一發火球，讓小鹿現出了他的真面目—煙霧之中，那雙翅膀再次展開，朝著燈塔頂端飛去。泰瓦爾於是利用奇術，大聲喊出怪物朝著燈塔飛去的消息。所有人都聽見了，並掉頭往燈塔奔去。

怪物先飛回到懸崖底下，將屍體拾起後回到了燈塔頂端，繼續吟唱。隨著咒語不斷持續，氣溫陡然下降。回到燈塔下方的南恩和泰瓦爾想起了手稿中的文字「只要手持炙熱的長槍貫穿僕人的心臟，僕人就會瞬間死亡」。南恩將撥火棒遞給伊努讓它加熱，然後遞給了拉雅米，用簡單的獸人語解釋作戰計畫：熾熱、長槍、心臟、貫穿。拉雅米點了點頭，然後便透過伊努的傳送術來到了燈塔頂端。眼前鮮血繪製而成的召喚法陣與吟唱中的怪物並沒有嚇到拉雅米，他舉起長槍，朝怪物的心臟刺下。怪物發出尖銳的嘶吼聲，然後倒下。
隨著怪物的死去，氣溫很快地就恢復正常，然後變得炎熱。來到塔頂的泰瓦爾看見他們此趟的目標：《雪の化身の目覚め》，正躺在儀式法陣的正中央。破損了。回到地面的泰瓦爾透過傳訊術，告知羅賓遜主教任務已經完成了，請求他派出船隻來進行救援。
冒險者們鬆了一口氣，卻沒注意到天空中出現的一道裂痕，一隻纏繞著雷霆以及冰雪的手臂從裂縫中向下抓了一把，大家倉皇閃躲。大家以為危機解除了，卻發現泰瓦爾落入了巨掌之中，消失在次元之外了。
數天之後，羅賓遜主教派了船隻將冒險者們從荒島送回了方努爾市。冒險者們也將殘破不堪的《雪の化身の目覚め》交還給了主教，並領取了獎賞。
也因為本次任務對津菈敎的重要性，冒險者們都被津菈敎奉為聖徒，而他們的冒險故事，都將成為津菈敎眾口耳相傳的傳說，永遠流傳。

The civil war within the Church of Keinra had not yet ended. Though his faction held the advantage, Bishop Robinson remained troubled. A spellbook kept in the church archives at Fanaur, 雪の化身の目覚め, had been stolen. How had it disappeared, and who was the thief? There were few clues, but Bishop Robinson already had an answer in mind.

The opposition in the Church of Keinra’s civil war was led by Syr Thomas Thompson, known as “Syr Great Wall.” 雪の化身の目覚め had most likely fallen into his hands, and he intended to use it to reverse his faction’s impending defeat.

At Bishop Robinson’s call, several heroes came to the church and accepted a mission to search an unnamed island for traces of 雪の化身の目覚め. They were the gnome Prince Hei-Hei-Hei, the halfling Fynn, the half-orcs Rayami and Nann, the elf Tyvar, and the human Inu. After the bishop’s briefing and some bargaining over their reward, the adventurers went to Fanaur’s harbor in search of the renowned Captain Marin.

Townspeople stared continuously at the strangely dressed and even more strangely behaved adventurers. When they finally reached the harbor, Fynn showed the guards Bishop Robinson’s letter of introduction, and they were escorted to Captain Marin’s ship. The adventurers introduced themselves one by one and boarded. An excited Rayami leaped directly from shore to deck, startling the sailors Nelson and his wife Hayes as they worked. After returning from a nearby shop with medicine for her headache, Captain Marin picked up a spray bottle and ordered the new crew to behave, or the sprayer would show them no mercy.

After asking what the newcomers needed, Captain Marin sent the final crew member, Ryon, to buy the tobacco Fynn requested and the tent and torches Inu wanted. Meanwhile, she showed the adventurers around the ship: the cabins, dining room, captain’s quarters, and lower cargo hold. Nann was particularly interested in the captain’s quarters, but found her personal cabinet locked when he tried to open it. The others were more interested in the mountain of bread below deck.

When Ryon returned, everyone collected their purchases and went to eat. In the dining room, Ryon told Nelson and Hayes about the recent war while Inu listened and asked about Syr Great Wall. Prince Hei-Hei-Hei asked Captain Marin about her relationship with the Church of Keinra. Nann’s body was in the dining room, but his thoughts remained in the captain’s quarters as he wondered what her bed smelled like. Rayami did not speak Common and never realized dinner had begun, so he went below and feasted on bread. Tyvar hid in the cabins and ate his own rations.

After dinner, Rayami went on deck to perform his customary “orcish war calisthenics.” Nann, also a half-orc, saw him and joined in. Tyvar, a War Domain cleric, objected and personally demonstrated the proper exercises. His masterful performance left both half-orcs ashamed. Only after Ryon warned them did everyone leave the deck and return to their berths.

Fynn took the whole box of premium cigars he had acquired and strolled toward the deck for a smoke, sharing one with Nann and another with Ryon, who was cleaning outside. Clouds obscured the night sky, lending it an ominous air. A spell-like chant sounded in the distance. Fynn and Nann felt a profound chill and saw an eerie red light gleaming through the darkness. Alarmed, Ryon hurried to inform Captain Marin. She came on deck and raised her spyglass, but the ship suddenly lurched as though it had struck something. Captain Marin sent Fynn and Nann below to summon their companions.

The passage from the berths to the deck was narrow. Prince Hei-Hei-Hei suddenly remembered that his belongings were still below and turned back, only to find seawater flooding the sleeping quarters. On the darkened deck, Inu tried to start a fire for light. Tyvar stopped him and instead used magic to make Inu’s crotch glow.

At the captain’s direction, Nann and Rayami lowered the port lifeboat while Nelson and Hayes handled the starboard boat. Eager to help but ignorant of pulleys and rigging, Rayami completely destroyed the port boat’s lowering mechanism. Captain Marin rushed to assist. With the help of a fireball from Prince Hei-Hei-Hei, they finally launched it. Ryon, Tyvar, Rayami, Inu, Nann, and Fynn descended to the sea in the port lifeboat, while Captain Marin, Nelson, Hayes, and Prince Hei-Hei-Hei took the starboard boat.
The lifeboats drifted farther and farther apart. By the time they reached the deserted island, the two groups were too distant to see one another.

Following the red light, Nann and Rayami rowed their boat onto the island’s beach. Exhausted, everyone nearly fell asleep on the sand, but a strange and piercing cold surrounded them. Rayami and Nann chopped firewood and built a fire, and only once the group had gathered around it did they gradually drift off.

In the other lifeboat, Captain Marin gave Prince Hei-Hei-Hei a warm coat. It carried none of the feminine fragrance he imagined, but instead an overpoweringly masculine odor. Under Marin’s navigation they landed on a beach beneath a cliff. Following the eerie red glow, the four climbed toward its source: a lighthouse atop the cliff. As the temperature fell, they entered without hesitation. The ground floor held a kitchen, lounge, and two bedrooms. To their surprise, an inspection found edible provisions in the kitchen cupboards. Using his darkvision, Prince Hei-Hei-Hei led the others into the woods to gather firewood, where they discovered a desiccated corpse with no obvious wounds. They brought it back for further study. Continuing their search, Prince Hei-Hei-Hei and Captain Marin found every lounge window boarded shut, and the prince discovered a longsword inside a locked metal cabinet.
The other group awoke after a short sleep. Despite their poor condition, they finally found the lighthouse, hurried inside, and reunited with their separated companions.

Continuing the investigation, Prince Hei-Hei-Hei found papers scattered throughout a bedroom. After collecting and sorting the handwritten drafts, he concluded that they were notes on 雪の化身の目覚め. There were many pages involving complex magic, and he would need uninterrupted time to finish them. Having rested enough, Tyvar took over the reading. Captain Marin sent Nelson and Hayes, who had slept earlier and were better rested, to gather more wood.

After returning with wood, Nelson and Hayes retired to a second-floor bedroom. Tyvar’s initial reading divided the notes into four subjects: the Lord of Winter, the ritual and living sacrifices needed to summon it, the Lord of Winter’s servant, and masks. An excited Tyvar reported his findings at three times his normal volume until Nelson, resting upstairs with his wife, scolded him and asked him to be quiet. Even Tyvar’s reduced volume annoyed Nelson, who went out alone for more wood. Tyvar explained that 雪の化身の目覚め was a spellbook for summoning the Lord of Winter. The entity would arrive with cold and blizzards, transforming the surrounding area into a frozen world the moment it fully manifested. Its summoning required many living sacrifices, and its servant would attempt the ritual. The notes described how to summon the servant and revealed its weakness: its frozen heart. Piercing that heart with a blazing spear would kill it instantly.

Everyone exchanged uneasy looks. Captain Marin asked where Nelson and Hayes were and learned that Nelson had gone back outside while Hayes rested upstairs. The group decided to continue searching the lighthouse.

As they entered the dark basement, Tyvar enchanted Rayami’s only garment—his underwear—to serve as a light. They immediately found a huge ritual diagram painted in blood across the floor, identical to one in the book. Fynn found a fire poker in the stove, while Inu discovered a journal containing passages such as: “Could this truly happen in reality? If it is real, how fragile is the civilized society humanity has built?”; “To summon a god here... Lowly and insignificant though I am, I will transform this world completely. But I cannot do it alone. Must I offer living sacrifices? Do I need an adviser? And what of the servant?”; and “At last, the day has come. I will transcend my existence and behold the dawn of a new world... If one can overturn a single convention, an entirely new theory may be built in its place.”

Wandering back on the ground floor, Fynn discovered the rear door. The moment he opened it, he saw mangled body parts scattered across the snow behind the lighthouse. Tyvar immediately shouted for everyone. The group investigated, but the cold forced them back inside. They went to Nelson and Hayes’s upstairs room to discuss their findings, only to feel freezing air leaking through the door. When they opened it, frigid wind rushed through an open window, accompanied by a fragrance and something heavy behind the door: Nelson’s head, its expression twisted in terror. Fynn ran back to the bodies outside and determined they had been torn apart by brute force and thrown directly from the second-floor window, but he could recall no animal capable of such a feat. Rayami searched around the lighthouse for more clues.
Prince Hei-Hei-Hei took over the notes from Tyvar and tried to finish them, but repeated interruptions left him furious. Upstairs, Inu found a storeroom packed with supplies.
Circling the lighthouse, Rayami saw more and more footprints before him. They had to be fresh! Convinced that he had found a vital clue, he hurried inside to report.

A cold more intense than anything before suddenly descended. Everyone ran outside, where Prince Hei-Hei-Hei saw a swaying figure chanting beside the red light atop the lighthouse. He hurled a fireball at it and missed, but still interrupted the ritual. Wings burst from the figure’s back, and it flew toward the forest.

Fynn drew a knife, cut his own arm, transformed into a wolf, and let Prince Hei-Hei-Hei climb onto his back before sprinting into the forest. At Nann’s shout, Rayami grabbed his greataxe and ran after them. Captain Marin retrieved the fire poker from the basement and gave it to Nann and Tyvar. Rayami moved so quickly that the two could only follow the distant glow of his enchanted underwear. As Fynn and the prince ran deeper, they passed growing numbers of dead animals. Watching from the clifftop, Inu shouted:

paragraphs.quote: “Did they go into the forest? I’m going to set the forest on fire.”
paragraphs.cite: Inu, a repeat arsonist (with tremendous potential)

paragraphs: Captain Marin hurriedly stopped Inu. In the forest, Tyvar and Nann saw a deer running toward the lighthouse, opposite all the other animals. Nann launched a fireball at it, revealing its true form. Wings spread once more through the smoke, carrying the creature toward the top of the lighthouse. Tyvar used thaumaturgy to shout that it was returning. Everyone heard and turned back.

The creature first flew beneath the cliff to collect a corpse, then returned to the lighthouse roof and resumed chanting. The temperature plummeted as the spell continued. Back at the lighthouse, Nann and Tyvar remembered the notes: “Pierce the servant’s heart with a blazing spear, and it will die instantly.” Nann gave Inu the fire poker to heat, then passed it to Rayami and explained the plan in simple Orcish: blazing, spear, heart, pierce. Rayami nodded, and Inu teleported him to the roof. Neither the blood-painted summoning circle nor the chanting monster frightened him. He raised the improvised spear and drove it through the creature’s heart. It shrieked and fell.

With the monster dead, the temperature quickly returned to normal and then became hot. Reaching the roof, Tyvar saw their objective, 雪の化身の目覚め, lying damaged at the center of the ritual circle. Back on the ground, he used a sending spell to tell Bishop Robinson that the mission was complete and request rescue.

The adventurers relaxed, failing to notice a rift opening in the sky. An arm wreathed in lightning and snow reached down through it, and everyone scrambled aside. Thinking the danger had passed, they then realized Tyvar had been caught in the colossal hand and carried beyond their plane.
Several days later, Bishop Robinson sent a ship to bring the adventurers back to Fanaur. They returned the badly damaged 雪の化身の目覚め and collected their reward.
Because the mission had been so important to the Church of Keinra, the adventurers were venerated as saints. The story of their deeds would become a legend passed forever among the faithful.
